title: Nakhasikho
text: 2. Atha kho Bhagavā parittam nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaram yo vāyam mayā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito || ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaram yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti || mahāpathavī upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || || [page 460] 460 Sacca-Saṃyuttam LVI. 3. Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etad eva bahutaraṃ dukkham || pe || yo Idaṃ dakkhanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || la [pe] || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāmini patipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānā ti || || 4. Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti || yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
